content: अनाचार {%a.%} Devoid of customary observances or duties, improper in behaviour, unprincipled, regardless of custom, law or propriety <ab>&c.</ab>; also अनाचारिन् in this sense. .{@-रः, -अनाचरणम्@} Absence of due observances or customary duties, improper conduct, departure from established usage or principle; अनाचार is of two kinds विहितस्य अननुष्ठानं निषिद्धस्य चानुष्टानम्.
